copy.select_first: Select objects first, then copy them with Ctrl+C.
copy.only_generated: Nothing was copied: junctions made by MapWorks each have their own object file, so they cannot be copied.
copy.done: Copied {count, plural, one {# object} other {# objects}}{attached, plural, =0 {} one { with # attached object} other { with # attached objects}}{left, plural, =0 {} one {; # junction made by MapWorks was left out} other {; # junctions made by MapWorks were left out}}.
